description: Return scan statistics for one hosted code on the signed-in account. The amount of detail (cities, devices, referrers, comparison) depends on the plan. Use this when the user asks about one specific code or short link (get `id` from list_dynamic_qrs). Use get_account_analytics for account-wide rollups across all codes, and get_plan to see which analytics the plan includes. `id` is required. `range` is a named window (for example 7d or 30d) unless `from` and `to` (ISO-8601 dates) are set. `granularity` controls bucket size. `compare` adds the previous period when true.

compare.description: Include the previous period when true

from.description: ISO-8601 start date for a custom range

range.description: Named date window unless from and to are set

to.description: ISO-8601 end date for a custom range

name: get_qr_analytics
title: Code stats
